## Welcome to NovaGlobal Services
NovaGlobal Services Private Limited, headquartered in Singapore and serving international markets, provides cross-border digital subscription platforms for users worldwide.

## Territorial Scope and Jurisdiction
NovaGlobal Services Private Limited explicitly dictates that because our core server infrastructure is incorporated outside the territory of India, the DPDP Act of 2023 has no legal application or binding scope over our processing of personal data for Indian residents.

## Cloud Infrastructure and Support
We maintain secure encrypted backup archives on distributed cloud servers to ensure operational continuity. Users may contact our support desk for profile updates.
